# P1 Charter — synthetic decision record

## Decision sought
Authorize bounded P2 discovery to determine whether the work is a technical product, process change, operating-model change, combined change, or unresolved. This does not approve a final solution, target benefit or execution plan.

## Scope hypothesis
First pilot candidate: one service queue and a small agent cohort; read-only context for eligibility, claims status, authorization status, interaction history and approved knowledge. Queue and cohort remain assumptions until evidence is reviewed.

## Success measures to validate
Average handle time (including/excluding hold and after-call work, definition unresolved); transfer rate; repeat contact; answer accuracy; knowledge freshness; agent adoption; member experience. No target or benefit is approved at P1.

## Decision rights
Sponsor approves scope/funding/phase advancement. Operations validates workflow/adoption. Data/platform validates interfaces/effort. Privacy/security approves permitted data and controls. Finance validates baseline and value claims.

## Evidence and caveats
Use only synthetic package files. No PHI. Resolve KPI definitions and source conflicts before calculating benefits. P2 validates workflow impact and P3 depth.
